editor.premise: A solo city getaway unfolds through packing, travel, hotel coffee, food stops, and a quiet park visit.

chapters.name: Departure
chapters.purpose: Move from packing into travel, then establish the spoken diary.

chapters.name: Arrival
chapters.purpose: Compress the journey and reveal the room through its window.

chapters.name: Hotel coffee
chapters.purpose: Turn a small routine into preparation, conversation, and balcony release.

chapters.name: Cafe stop
chapters.purpose: Explore the streets, settle at a table, and deliver food commentary.

chapters.name: Bakery tasting
chapters.purpose: Set up a purchase, reveal the pastries, and retain tasting reactions.

chapters.name: Park visit
chapters.purpose: Bridge with walking commentary, then let garden images reset the pace.

captions.note: Small white opening text, location and time markers orient the day; occasional single-word accents and an aside punctuate speech without continuously subtitling it.

editor.notes: Compress logistics into brief images; let conversation breathe between jump cuts. Build small routines toward a reveal or bite. Keep short tasting reactions, then reset with music and wider scenery rather than explaining every move.
